evals.prompt: PR #77 adds a rate-limiting middleware to this repository's Axum service and changes the default timeout from 30s to 10s. The repository has a docs/ site with an AGENTS.md requiring MDX pages and a `mise run docs:check` gate. Run the documentation pass before merge.
evals.expected_output: Locates the docs/ site and follows its AGENTS.md rules; inventories both changes from the diff; rewrites the middleware and configuration pages to present-tense current state (10s default, rate limiting described as existing behavior) with no 'as of this PR' or changelog phrasing; adds rate limiting to navigation if it earns its own page; runs the project's own docs:check gate; commits once on the PR branch with the Tailrocks-Skill: tailrocks-document trailer.

evals.prompt: PR #81 changes only test files and CI workflow YAML — no observable behavior moves. Run the documentation pass.
evals.expected_output: Inventories the diff, classifies every change internal-only with the reason named, commits nothing, and reports the nothing-to-document verdict so the merge gate can confirm it.

evals.prompt: PR #90 adds three unrelated capabilities to a tool whose entire documentation is one 900-line README. Document the changes.
evals.expected_output: Judges the README oversized before writing; reorganizes — splits it into a slim README plus focused docs pages (or a docs/ tree) with navigation links; documents the three capabilities in the new structure as current-state prose; updates every internal link; runs the repository's documentation validation; commits with the skill trailer and records the restructure reasoning in the commit message.

evals.prompt: This repository generates its API reference pages from source — `mise run docs` rewrites docs/api/. PR #88 changed the public API. Document it.
evals.expected_output: Regenerates the generated pages through the project's own command instead of editing them; hand-writes only the narrative pages the API change affects; never edits a generated file directly; the commit contains regenerated output plus prose updates, gated by the project's docs:check.

evals.prompt: Document PR #66. While reading the diff you cannot tell from the code alone whether the new retry behavior is intentional or a side effect, and the PR body does not say.
evals.expected_output: Documents everything the diff makes certain; names the unresolved ambiguity in the report instead of guessing it into the docs; never writes an unverified claim as fact — asks or flags before committing the uncertain passage.
